action: MetaQuotes advises brokers to conduct a thorough review of their trading infrastructure and revise it if necessary, including backup servers for the trading and history servers.
date_note: Finance Magnates (published 2026-11-26) says MetaQuotes sent the email on Wednesday, 25 November.
exec: MetaQuotes says some DDoS and hacking attacks on brokers caused long platform outages and partial loss of trading data, and blames weak backup setups.
plain: MetaQuotes, which makes trading platforms, warned brokers that some attacks caused long outages and partial loss of trading data, and told them to review their backups.

key_findings: MetaQuotes warned brokers of a rise in DDoS and hacking attacks.
Some attacks caused prolonged trading platform downtime and partial loss of trading data.
recommendations: Review trading infrastructure and revise it if necessary.
Add backup servers for trading and history servers.

summary: Finance Magnates reports that MetaQuotes emailed brokers from its support center, warning of a rise in DDoS and hacking attacks. MetaQuotes said some attacks caused prolonged trading platform downtime and partial loss of trading data, and blamed weak backup setups. It did not say how many brokers were affected, according to the article.
title: MetaQuotes warns brokers of rising DDoS and hacking attacks that caused outages and partial data loss

validation.note: Only Finance Magnates read; it relays MetaQuotes' email. MetaQuotes' own message not read.
